chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a lone drip echoes in the dark, then the low drone breathes in beneath it}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
a deep bronze bell tolling a slow four-note phrase
sparse high triangle plinks like water dripping into still pools
a soft pulse-wave echo answering from far away
flooded stone cellar in the dark, ancient and quiet
